name: 100x-segment
description: Validation tooling for the 100x-segment skill (SegmentBundle output contract). Not published -- this package.json exists only so scripts/validate.js can pull in ajv for real JSON Schema enforcement (structural checks: required/additionalProperties/enum/pattern) instead of a hand-rolled re-implementation. Cross-field/cross-array checks that JSON Schema draft-07 cannot express (text_annotated<->raw_text integrity, shots<->segments referential integrity + zero-orphan coverage, sequential ids, breath-mark placement parsing) stay hand-written in scripts/validate.js -- see that file's header comment and axioms.md.
